note: Geometry 28 (ARIA 24 plus Type and Space) at n 14, standard preset, tile depth 5q, dialogs 80q wide. The suffix is the canvas width. The five rows need 1,509px of height, so the canvas is 1280 × 1600. The eight ARIA 24 minimums are those of aria-24-1280, measured from its reference sheet. Type and Space were measured with the in-page checker in headless Chromium, each alone in a tile with this chrome, in the system-ui face: the smallest tile that passes, and 1px less in either direction fails. They hold for the reference specimens the brief describes (the sample Ag per role with its note; rungs 24q wide; frames around a 20q × h block). Other specimens, or another typeface, need their own measurements.
